    // The sense of this axis: +1 for the positive faces, -1 for the negative faces.
    Sign(self: SignedAxis3D): Integer
        => match (self) {
            PosX => 1;
            NegX => -1;
            PosY => 1;
            NegY => -1;
            PosZ => 1;
            NegZ => -1;
